svg.title: Automated versus reference phenotype counts across evaluated cohorts
svg.desc: Two separately scored cohorts share square-root axes. The historical cardiac cohort and opened mixed-gold candidate runs are not pooled. Missing automated counts are evaluated as zero only for scoring and display.
svg.metadata: Historical source: 20260902_false_zero_recovery_gold118 Mixed sources: scored candidate arms listed in versioned mixed-gold consumption logs Overlap rule: cohorts remain separate; no deduplication or pooled metric
